title: Monday Night Football: Jeffery Simmons, Caleb Williams lead Bears to 34-17 rout of Seahawks

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Monday Night Football: Jeffery Simmons, Caleb Williams lead Bears to 34-17 rout of Seahawks
sources.description: The Bears acquired Simmons on Thursday, and he had six tackles and a sack, and Williams threw for 247 yards.
